name: Source absence read as removal
summary: A finding concludes that tracking stopped because the identifier is no longer in the page source.
not_a_vulnerability: A fault in a measurement, not in a system. Loading tags from a container is ordinary practice and no defect; the error is in reading the source and concluding what the traffic does.

mechanism.what: A tag manager loads measurement or advertising tags at runtime, so the identifiers of those tags are not in the delivered HTML. A check that reads the source therefore reports absence while the traffic shows presence. The container is also the reason an operator can change what runs without changing the site, which is why a source-based finding says nothing about a different day either.
mechanism.why_it_matters: A researcher who checks only the source concludes that tracking stopped when it did not, and publishes reassurance that the traffic contradicts. The same error runs the other way in a dispute: an operator can point at a clean source while the container keeps loading what it always did.
common_causes: tags migrated from hardcoded to container-managed
marketing team with dashboard access and no deployment
a check built on fetching HTML because that is cheap, without a capture beside it
mechanism.not_this: A recipient that is genuinely present and unnamed in the privacy statement is Undisclosed recipient, a fault of the system. This entry is about the claim: absence from the source is not absence from the wire.

detection.indicator: The finding rests on the fetched HTML document, and a network capture of the same page shows a property or measurement identifier that the document does not contain. The difference between the two sets is the fault in the claim.
capture_requirements: fetch and retain the HTML document in the same capture
search for the full identifier and for split forms; dynamic assembly would otherwise be missed

falsifiers.condition: The identifier is present in the source but assembled dynamically.
The initiator is another script rather than the container.

methods.expect: no dedicated reproduction exists yet; follow the general method and the indicator above
the run reports DPE-2026-0011 as present, with the detail behind it

rebuttals.objection: We removed the tracking; it is not in our code.
rebuttals.answer: Absence from the source is not absence from the traffic. The container is the reliable indicator, and its version history shows what ran when.

seen_in_the_wild.note: Observed in practice by the authors but not yet backed by a published reference. Set to false until a citation exists: a claim without a source is exactly what this catalogue holds others to.

does_not_establish: harm; the catalogue standardises a finding so it can be referred to, it does not weigh it
severity; there is no score here, by design. Weighing belongs to whoever applies the entry to a concrete case
unlawfulness; that is for a supervisory authority or a court
intent; a fault is usually a build decision, not a plan
absence: not finding it in one capture is not evidence that it is not there
name_nl: Afwezig in de broncode telt als verwijderd
summary_nl: Een bevinding concludeert dat de tracking weg is omdat de identifier niet meer in de broncode staat.

in_practice.dpia: Test a claim that tracking was removed against a capture of the same page, never against the page source alone.
in_practice.procurement: A statement that a tag was removed is delivered with a capture of the page beside the source, and with the container version history.
in_practice.complaint: The capture and the fetched HTML document of the same page, side by side, with the identifiers present in one and absent from the other.
in_practice.audit_question: Who can add measurement code to the site without changing the site, and where is the record of what was added?
in_practice.audit_question_nl: Wie kan er meetcode aan de site toevoegen zonder dat er iets aan de site verandert, en waar staat wat er is toegevoegd?
in_practice.complaint_nl: De opname naast de opgehaalde broncode van dezelfde pagina, plus de versiegeschiedenis van de tagcontainer. Een uitdraai van alleen de broncode toont over het verkeer niets aan.
in_practice.objection_nl: Wij hebben de tracking verwijderd, het staat niet in onze code.
in_practice.answer_nl: Afwezig in de broncode is niet afwezig in het verkeer. Alleen een opname naast die broncode toont aan wat er werkelijk vertrekt.
